depth_normalization: Both repeats scaled to WT rep1 library pair count before log transform
normalization_fit: Exact 99.5% training-only log-count quantile from integer histogram
checkpoint_selection: Validation MSE; representative seed42 chosen in advance
loss: Native MSE + 0.2 MSE of 160bp pooled intensity
downstream_classifier: Per-locus out-of-fold classifier, no test-locus class labels in its fitting
limitations: MPS bitwise determinism not guaranteed across machines
targets clip top 0.5% training intensity; clipping reference separately evaluated downstream
same-source spatial holdout and one withheld repeat, not external-source validation
classifier agreement is a recovery proxy, not independent biological confirmation
only annotated structures fully inside SR test blocks are evaluated downstream
